regressionNote: story-044 added uint256 return value to deposit(). Pure interface change; no implementation logic present.
summary: Pure Solidity interface with no implementation. Defines the canonical API for yield strategy adapters. The sole change in story-044 was adding `returns (uint256 creditedPrincipal)` to `deposit()`. All other function signatures are unchanged.

externalEntryPoints.function: deposit(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient) returns (uint256 creditedPrincipal)
externalEntryPoints.notes: NEW return value (story-044): credited principal booked against recipient. For ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy this is the slippage-haircut amount, NOT the nominal amount. For direct strategies it equals amount. ABI-backward-compatible: old callers ignoring return value are unaffected.

balanceOf(address token, address account) view returns (uint256)

totalBalanceOf(address token, address account) view returns (uint256)

externalEntryPoints.notes: Two-phase timelocked migration withdrawal: Phase 1 initiates 24h wait, Phase 2 executes within 48h window.

externalEntryPoints.function: skimSurplus(address token, address recipient) returns (uint256 underlyingReceived)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Returns actual underlying delivered to recipient. IMPORTANT: when set-aside buffers are configured, this is LESS than total underlying extracted from the vault (difference goes to clients). Callers wanting total yield must also track buffer distributions.
